Name: Longer Lasting Lures
Author: caraxi
Description:
Allows configuration of the lifespan of fishing tackle as well as increasing the lifespan the higher your fishing level.

[b]Default Configuration:
[/b]20 Uses at Fishing Level 0
Add 8 uses per Fishing Level for a total of 100 uses at Fishing Level 10

[b]Configuration:[/b]

[code]﻿  DefaultMaxUses: [Default: 20] The number of uses available at Fishing Level 0
  IncreaseMaxUsesWithFishingLevel: [Default: 8] The number of uses to add for every Fishing Level gained.[/code]

Downloads.Description:
Updated to support SMAPI 3.0
Thanks to Pathoschild
